XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Lambda sensor

  • Fault: Engine fault warning light illuminates sporadically on the instrument panel, whilst the vehicle is operating correctly.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0036 (Lambda sensor 2 heating circuit, bank 2 – Malfunction)

  • Cause: Downstream lambda sensor after the catalytic converter malfunctioning

• Action: Check the condition of the lambda sensor downstream of the catalytic converter and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the component showed no abnormalities upon visual inspection. After replacement, it is not necessary to reprogram the vehicle using diagnostic equipment.
